title: Nehemiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Nehemiah 6: plots against Nehemiah fail, and the wall is finished in fifty-two days.

questions.text: Where did Sanballat and Geshem want to meet the narrator?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 6:2 says they asked to meet in the villages in the plain of Ono.

questions.text: What answer did the narrator send to their invitation?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 6:3 says he sent messengers saying, "I am doing a great work, so that I can't come down."

questions.text: What did Sanballat's servant have in his hand the fifth time?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 6:5 says he came the fifth time with an open letter in his hand.

answers.text: A sealed scroll from the king

questions.text: Who, according to the letter, was saying that "you and the Jews" intended to rebel?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 6:6 says, "It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says it."

questions.text: What did the letter say prophets were appointed to proclaim in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 6:7 says the letter claimed prophets were proclaiming, "There is a king in Judah!"

answers.text: "The wall will fall in a day!"

questions.text: What did Shemaiah the son of Delaiah urge the narrator to do?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 6:10 says Shemaiah said, "Let us meet together in God's house, within the temple, and let's shut the doors of the temple."

answers.text: Flee to the plain of Ono
Go back to Susa the palace
Stop building the wall at once
Hide in the temple and shut the doors

questions.explanation: Nehemiah 6:12 says Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

questions.text: Which prophetess is named among those who would have put the narrator in fear?

questions.explanation: Nehemiah 6:15 says the wall was finished on the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.

questions.text: Why were many in Judah sworn to Tobiah?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 6:18 says he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah.

answers.text: He was the governor of Judah
He had paid for the wall
He was a priest in the temple
